verdict.rationale: Latham documents a dedicated Privacy & Cyber practice that it describes as highly ranked, interdisciplinary and global, covering 'compliance, regulatory, litigation, and transactional challenges.' Its Technology Transactions page adds work on helping clients 'develop secure and compliant platforms and products.' Missing for 10: no named regimes (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP or local equivalents) in the evidence, no detail on specific compliance services, and no independent corroboration or rankings citation.
